svg.title: ActionRelay by CDIT — six-agent workflow, bounded writes and return loops
svg.desc: This diagram shows the approved target architecture. The current app wires Admin-authorized Coordinator and Triage, a version-bound Auditor pause, sequential local Knowledge, Troubleshooting, Escalation and Documentation, and a deterministic resource outcome path. Persisted stages are shown together by exact case version. Parallel joins, the normalized event ledger, broader correction loops and production integrations remain design or validation work.
svg.text: Approved synthetic design · Six runtime agents · Application write gate outside the model · Return loops retain provenance

path.title: Synthetic intake to Coordinator — Validated intake
Coordinator to Triage — Case/version packet
Triage to Knowledge — Issue + source scope
Triage to Escalation — Facts + policy
Knowledge to Version join — Evidence + versions
Escalation to Version join — Trigger/no-trigger
Version join to Troubleshooting — Validated join
Troubleshooting to Documentation — Supported procedure
Documentation to Outcome gate — Cited response candidate
Outcome gate to Application write gate — All checks pass
Application write gate to Atomic local commit — Bounded operation
Outcome gate to Human review — Exception / unknown
Application write gate to Human review — Denied gate → review
Human review to Versioned correction — Reasoned correction
Versioned correction to Revalidate dependencies — New case/run version
Revalidate dependencies to Coordinator — Revalidate affected stages
Human review to Admin feedback — Admin inspects version
Admin feedback to Human review — Optional feedback
Knowledge to Transient retry — Transient dependency only
Transient retry to Knowledge — Same failed checkpoint
Atomic local commit to Write recovery — Commit acknowledgement uncertain
Write recovery to Atomic local commit — Lookup → revalidate → same key
Write recovery to Human review — Unknown ledger result → human
Atomic local commit to Versioned state and metadata — Operation metadata
Admin feedback to Versioned state and metadata — Versioned feedback history

g.aria-label: Synthetic intake. A0–A1. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Authenticated User request or scoped Staff case, current case version and synthetic-data marker. Corrected input starts a new version. Rejected input does not dispatch specialists.

g.aria-label: Coordinator. A0–A1. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Acknowledged intake artifact, actor scope, case version and versioned routing policy. Revalidation returns here after a reasoned correction. Transient retry preserves the same checkpoint identity.

g.aria-label: Triage. A2. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Case facts, item/source spans and versioned category/urgency policy. An accepted human correction creates a new case/decision version and revalidates Triage plus affected downstream stages.

g.aria-label: Knowledge. A3. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Scoped issue, current approved-resource registry and source-policy versions. After bounded transient recovery, retry this same checkpoint. Source correction invalidates Knowledge and downstream dependents.

g.aria-label: Escalation. A5. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Validated case and Triage output, approved escalation policy. May run parallel with Knowledge. Changed category/band, impact facts or policy requires this check again before any new action.

g.aria-label: Version join. Join. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Knowledge and Escalation artifacts with acknowledged receipt and validation results. A new run must not consume an older run’s late branch. Re-run the affected branch when corrected.

g.aria-label: Troubleshooting. A4. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Version-matched evidence, policy and classification bundle. Changed evidence or case facts invalidate affected troubleshooting and later response assembly.

g.aria-label: Documentation. A6. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Supported procedure, verified facts, source references and uncertainty. Revised evidence or facts create a new response artifact. Earlier text remains attributable.

g.aria-label: Outcome gate. Outcome. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Validated agent outputs, all-item completion, source/policy versions and stop flags. Corrections run again through required gates. No human feedback can bypass the outcome gate.

g.aria-label: Application write gate. A7. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Typed candidate, live identity/capability, case version, approved procedure and current resource mapping. A denied write needs revalidation or human action. A changed case cannot reuse stale authority.

g.aria-label: Atomic local commit. Commit. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Gate-approved operation with expected case version and unique operation key. Uncertain commit enters ledger lookup. Report success only after verifying persistence.

g.aria-label: Human review. A7 human. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Known facts, source references, unknowns, trigger and requested human decision. A reasoned correction takes the new-version loop. Optional Admin feedback may leave the decision unchanged.

g.aria-label: Versioned correction. New version. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: New verified facts, revised classification or evidence correction. Version-aware invalidation reruns affected checkpoints. No unreviewed rule promotion or online learning.

g.aria-label: Revalidate dependencies. Return loop. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Corrected version, parent run and dependency/provenance graph. Returns to Coordinator. Category/band changes revalidate Triage and affected later work.

g.aria-label: Transient retry. Bounded retry. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: A classified transient dependency failure with a retryable idempotent stage. Illustrated Knowledge return is an example. Retry only the checkpoint that failed, not a full unbounded restart. Numeric budgets remain open.

g.aria-label: Write recovery. Ledger lookup. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Commit timeout, lost acknowledgement or duplicate request with original operation key. The retry arrow to commit means same-key recovery after revalidation, not new authority.

g.aria-label: Admin feedback. Optional loop. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: One case/decision-version ID and the exact author account. Auditor can leave the decision unchanged. An independently reasoned revision follows the correction loop.

g.aria-label: Versioned state and metadata. Storage boundary. Select to inspect inputs, checks, outputs and return path.
g.title: Correlated case/run/stage artifacts and application operations. Correction/retry/feedback histories remain distinct. Retention and reset follow PRD-v4 §4d.
g.text: Case store and immutable contributions · operation ledger · decision/feedback history
Product Health projection contains allowlisted metadata only
